input: Buy and frame a vintage map for the study

gold.taskTitle: Buy and frame a vintage map for the study
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to source a vintage map and have it framed to display in their study room.

questions.title: What region or subject should the map depict?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a world map, a specific country, city, historical region, or another theme.

questions.title: Do you have a target era or time period in mind?
questions.description: Clarify whether the map needs to be from a specific historical period, such as 1800s, early 1900s, or any vintage style.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this purchase?
questions.description: Determine the combined budget for both the map itself and the framing costs.

questions.title: What are the wall dimensions available in your study?
questions.description: Find out the available wall space so the map and frame size can be matched appropriately.

questions.title: Do you need an authentic antique or a reproduction print?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a genuinely old original map or a high-quality reproduction printed in a vintage style.

questions.title: What frame style fits your study decor?
questions.description: Understand the existing decor preferences, such as dark wood, gold gilt, simple black, or rustic, to match the frame style.

questions.title: Do you plan to frame it yourself or use a professional framer?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a DIY framing approach or prefers to use a professional custom framing service.
